sequential_dependency.intermediate: An input-dependent per-template map of selected anchor color, anchor multiplicity, matching standalone object, and valid translation vector(s).
sequential_dependency.step_a: For each multicolor template, count each template color and use the episode relation to select the color whose multiplicity matches a same-color standalone object; then align the complete selected-color cell pattern to that object to derive translation vectors.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Consume those translation vectors to stamp every template cell at each selected target, then, only after a successful stamp, erase non-anchor source cells whose template color is unique.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The stamp destinations and the anchor/non-anchor partition are not fixed by geometry or position: they are produced by the size-relation match in step A. Using the wrong anchor-size relation selects different standalone objects and therefore changes the final grid.
